# ui::AutomationProviders

Header: `winui/ui/Automation.hpp`.

What a node lets an accessibility client do: one pointer per pattern, null for a pattern it does not support. [Element::automation_providers()](element.md#automation_providers) fills it.

Example: 
```cpp
// Click a button the way a screen reader does.
ui::ButtonControl button{"Save"};
if (ui::InvokeProvider* invoke = ui::automation_providers(button).invoke)
{
    invoke->invoke();
}
```

| `invoke` | `InvokeProvider*` | `nullptr` | The Invoke pattern. |
| `toggle` | `ToggleProvider*` | `nullptr` | The Toggle pattern. |
| `selection_item` | `SelectionItemProvider*` | `nullptr` | The SelectionItem pattern. |
| `selection` | `SelectionProvider*` | `nullptr` | The Selection pattern. |
| `expand_collapse` | `ExpandCollapseProvider*` | `nullptr` | The ExpandCollapse pattern. |
| `range_value` | `RangeValueProvider*` | `nullptr` | The RangeValue pattern. |
| `value` | `ValueProvider*` | `nullptr` | The Value pattern. |
| `scroll` | `ScrollProvider*` | `nullptr` | The [Scroll](../layout/scroll.md#uiscroll) pattern. |
| `grid` | `GridProvider*` | `nullptr` | The [Grid](../layout/grid.md#uigrid) pattern. |

| `table` | `TableProvider*` | `nullptr` | The Table pattern. |
